sources.title: GitHub - yushuaisong/RefReward-SR: [ECCV2026] RefReward-SR: LR ...
sources.snippet: In this work, we propose RefReward-SR, a low-resolution (LR) reference-aware reward model for preference-aligned SR. Instead of relying on GT supervision or NR evaluation, RefReward-SR assesses high-resolution (HR) reconstructions conditioned on their LR inputs, treating the LR image as a semantic anchor.
